source: Dimensions that recurred (>= 2 uses) in the ND-0 BabyTest extraction, de-duplicated. Fixed for a whole run so every stateless session sees the same book.
rule: Use one of these names when it fits. Invent a new snake_case name only when none fits.

dimensions.role_in_event: the entity's role in this event (proposer, questioner, reporter, speaker, requester, recipient, reviewer, holder, subject, object)
dimensions.action: what the entity did, in the sentence's words
dimensions.context: system or setting the event happens in
dimensions.target_system: system an action or proposal is aimed at
dimensions.position: a stance or preference the entity holds
dimensions.owner: who or what something belongs to
dimensions.outcome: result of a test, decision or action
dimensions.status: current state of the entity as stated
dimensions.decision_status: state of a decision (pending, made, not recorded)
dimensions.epistemic_source: who the information comes from ("according to X", "X reported")
dimensions.epistemic_stance: hedging or certainty in the sentence (might, possibly, certain)
dimensions.temporal_position: when, relative to the sentence (past, before X, after X)
dimensions.type: what kind of thing the entity is, in the sentence's words
dimensions.reference_status: set to "unresolved" when this entity is a reference (he, she, it, its, they, the X) the sentence alone does not resolve
